# Shariful Hasan Roky — Performance Marketer

> Performance marketer for home services and DTC ecommerce brands. Managed $6.5M+ in tracked ad spend across 22 brands in 18 months.

## Who I am

I'm Shariful Hasan Roky, an independent performance marketer based in Dhaka, Bangladesh. I build full-funnel paid + lifecycle systems for home services owners and DTC ecommerce founders across the US, Canada, UK, and Australia.

## What I do

I run a 6-chapter system for every client, in this order: **campaign → business → scaling → numbers → measurements → growth**. Skip one and scale breaks at month 9.

- **Campaign**: Hook-led creative testing on Meta, Google, TikTok, YouTube. Server-side tracking with CAPI. Weekly creative refresh.
- **Business**: Unit economics, CAC:LTV modeling, offer engineering, cash-cycle aware budget pacing.
- **Scaling**: Horizontal + vertical scaling, budget laddering (20% bumps every 48-72h), SOP-ized so it survives team churn.
- **Numbers**: Revenue, MER (blended ROAS), blended CAC, payback period — the only four numbers that move a business.
- **Measurements**: Server-side GTM + Conversions API, unified data warehouse (BigQuery/Snowflake), MMM + incrementality for channels above $50k/mo.
- **Growth**: Lifecycle email/SMS, brand creative, referral loops, quarterly growth experiments.

## Numbers (last 18 months)

- Ad spend managed: **$6.5M+** across 22 brands
- Average client revenue lift: **168%** within first 6 months
- Client retention (12-month rolling): **94%**
- Industries served: **14+** (home services, DTC, local, specialty)

## Case studies (23 total)

### Featured (2)
- **Atelier Nord** — Sydney, Australia. Premium menswear Shopify store. Cut returns from 38% to 14% (−63%) with AR size-finder + size-quiz funnel. Mobile conversion +143%. AOV +72%.
- **PristinePro Cleaning** — Calgary, AB, Canada. Subscription residential cleaning. Subscription CAC $48 (−57%). 12-month retention 62% (+24pts). MRR $96k (+187%).

- Meira Fine Jewelry — Los Angeles, CA. $1 try-at-home → 29% purchase rate.
- VitalRoot Wellness (supplements) — Miami, FL. CAC −47%. 14.8k subs (from 4.2k).

## How I work

- Remote-first, based in Dhaka, Bangladesh (GMT+6)
- Async with one live 30-min call per week
- Slack for day-to-day, Loom for walk-throughs, written monthly reports
- Direct ownership — no junior account managers, no agency handoff
- 90-day initial engagement, then month-to-month with 30 days' notice
- Minimum engagement: $5k/mo ad spend

## Industries served

Plumbing, handyman, printing, roofing, electrician, cleaning, yarn & crafts, car repair, ecommerce (gadgets, cosmetics, clothing, telecom, sports, pet supplies, coffee, home decor, jewelry, supplements, baby & kids, outdoor gear, watches, audio accessories, gifting), HVAC, pest control, landscaping, pet care, fitness.

- Paid: Meta Ads, Google Ads (Search, PMax, LSA), TikTok Ads, YouTube Ads

## Site structure

This site is a single-page Next.js 16 application with client-side view switching. The navbar exposes: Story, Pillars, Numbers, About, Portfolio, Case Studies, CV, Book a Call. All content is rendered into the DOM on initial page load and accessible to JavaScript-capable crawlers.
